basic_info.description: Here is the Infinity's rare Signature 1-bedroom, the largest 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom plus den with a balcony and bright courtyard views. 338 Spear, the tallest tower at 42 floors, one of the 4 Infinity buildings, features a striking wave-like glass façade. Well-maintained and well-appointed with hardwood floors throughout, Studio Becker cabinetry, Bosch range, Thermador refrigerator, custom Hunter Douglas window treatments, high-end Miele in-unit washer/dryer & one deeded secured garage parking with sought-after EV charger complete the home. Designed by Arquitectonica and Heller Manus Architects, they created this luxurious urban living in one of the most desirable areas, adjacent to the downtown financial district & along San Francisco’s waterfront, complete with a full suite of luxury amenities. Amenities include 24-hr concierge, club room with full catering kitchen, 5000 SF professional quality fitness center, 75-foot lap pool, sauna, theater room, business center & more. This home is a pleasant walk to Union Square, world-class waterfront restaurants, the Ferry Building, Oracle Park & the Financial District. Easy access to public transportation, 101, 280, 80, & the Bay Bridge, this location provides excellent connectivity to the city & the Bay Area.
